description: This file defines the CredentialsClient interface in the org.eclipse.hono.client package, which provides methods for accessing Hono's Credentials API. It includes method signatures for retrieving credentials by device type and authentication ID, with optional client context and tracing support.

classes.name: CredentialsClient
classes.description: An interface for a client accessing Hono's Credentials API, scoped to a specific tenant.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves credentials for a device by type and auth ID, returning a Future with CredentialsObject; supports an optional client context.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves credentials with additional client context parameter.

methods.description: Default method that calls the other get method with client context, supports tracing via SpanContext.
